title: Open Receipt Format v0.6
description: Machine-readable schema for ORF v0.6 records. Use with any JSON Schema validator (ajv, jsonschema, gojsonschema, etc.). See spec/orf-v0.6.md for field semantics.

type.description: string: free-form text (v0.1 compat); uri: resolvable reference + failure condition; predicate: checkable expression

window_seconds.description: How long the falsifier window stays open; check before expiry

falsifier.description: What would prove this decision wrong — a string (v0.1 compat) or a typed object (v0.2+ preferred for automatic checkability).

idempotency_key.description: Prevents double-spend on retry — write intent receipt before acting

settled.description: false at write time (intent); update to true when confirmed

decision_id.description: Decision ID in the orchestrator's ledger, or an orf:// URI for cross-ledger sub-tasks; may reference decision, delegation, or reconcile records

status.description: Status of this sub-task; partial indicates the sub-task was itself an orchestrator with mixed results

resolution_policy_enum.description: How to interpret a partial outcome. any_falsified_is_failure: one falsified sub-task → decision is falsified. majority_held_is_success: held > falsified → held; held == falsified → ambiguous; held < falsified → falsified. custom (or absent): consumer applies its own rules.

total.description: Total number of sub-tasks in this cycle

held.description: Count of sub-tasks with status held

falsified.description: Count of sub-tasks with status falsified

undetermined.description: Count of sub-tasks with status undetermined

partial.description: Count of sub-tasks with status partial (added in v0.4); held + falsified + undetermined + (partial ?? 0) must equal total

resolution_policy.description: Which policy was applied when computing outcome.status from this aggregate breakdown. Makes the aggregate self-documenting. New in v0.6.

sub_outcomes.description: Per-sub-task detail; length must equal total

orf_version.description: v0.1–v0.5 records are valid v0.6 (fully backward compatible)

id.description: Unique within the ledger; idempotency key for the receipt (not the action)

actor_agent.description: Identity of the agent taking the action

intent.description: Why: the goal this action serves

precondition_read.description: State actually observed before acting — not assumed, observed

decision_rule.description: Rule or policy in force at decision time — recorded now, not reconstructed later

action.description: What was done — specific enough to replay or audit

action_idempotency_key.description: Key for the side-effect boundary — distinct from the receipt id (different idempotency gates)

confidence.description: Agent's stated confidence [0..1] that the action achieves its intent — enables calibration

reconstruction_class.description: recomputable: can be rebuilt from still-available inputs (evictable); irrecoverable: original is irreplaceable (must be pinned)

resolution_policy.description: How to interpret a partial outcome from this decision. New in v0.5.

spend.description: Present when the action involves expenditure; null when none

artifacts.description: Paths or references to supporting artifacts; orf://{ledger-name}/{decision-id} is the recognized cross-ledger format

decision_id.description: The id of the resolved decision or delegation record

falsifier_observed.description: Did the falsifying condition occur? false=held; true=falsified; null=undetermined or partial

status.description: Derived from falsifier_observed: false→held; true→falsified; null→undetermined or partial (use partial when aggregate shows held>0 AND falsified>0)

artifacts.description: Paths or references to supporting evidence; orf:// URIs are the recognized cross-ledger format

aggregate.description: Optional structured breakdown of sub-task outcomes for multi-tool/sub-agent cycles

orf_version.description: reconcile is a v0.2+ record type; v0.1 implementations do not emit it

open_decision_id.description: The id of the decision or delegation record being reconciled

world_state_read.description: What was actually observed in the world on waking — the authoritative crash-gap check

gap_detected.description: Did the agent find a gap between the pre-sleep receipt and actual world state?

resolution.description: completed: no gap; not_completed: safe to retry; ambiguous: do not retry without manual review. For partial prior outcomes, see reconcile guidance in spec/orf-v0.5.md.

prior_outcome_status.description: Optional. The status of the prior outcome record being reconciled. Makes reconcile reasoning self-contained. New in v0.5.

notes.description: Explanation of resolution — required in practice when resolution=ambiguous

orf_version.description: delegation is a v0.3+ record type

delegated_intent.description: What the orchestrator instructed the sub-agent to do — the assignment, not just the tool name

delegate_ledger.description: orf:// URI for the sub-agent's receipt ledger; enables crash recovery by pointing to where B's receipts will appear

parent_decision_id.description: The orchestrator's own cycle or decision record that triggered this delegation

action_idempotency_key.description: Key for the invocation boundary — same semantics as in decision records

falsifier.description: Condition that would indicate the sub-agent failed to execute the delegated task
